execution_abort.note: Closes a session and records it.

execution_create_recorder.note: Builds an object. The result is only a text label over MCP.

execution_reconcile.note: Writes the calibration counts and the session after a night.

execution_run.note: Needs callables that MCP cannot send. No MCP use today.

observatory_equipment_connect.note: Opens the INDI session. Not a device command, but the status tools already open it on demand.

observatory_equipment_get_active.note: Reads the active observatory configuration: the telescope, cameras and other equipment in use.

observatory_equipment_get_status.note: Reads the active equipment, camera profiles, site, commissioning records and the INDI device list. The INDI sections use the connect-only path.

observatory_equipment_set_active.note: Writes the active telescope and camera into the configuration file.

observatory_equipment_set_device_propert.note: Sets a raw INDI property, which commands a device. Belongs to the dropped control side.

observatory_equipment_set_pointing_limit.note: Writes the telescope's safety limits into the configuration file.

observatory_guiding_capture.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_guiding_create_guider_calibr.note: Saves a guider calibration record to the database. It sends nothing to a device, but the delegation rules trust the record, and the AI is read-only. Read the saved one with observatory_guiding_status.

observatory_guiding_get_status.note: Reads the saved guider calibration, the mount's periodic error model and the guide plate scale (no device needed), and with include=['live'] the guiding going on now and its RMS error.

observatory_guiding_query_guider_calibra.note: Lists every saved guider calibration, for all telescope and camera pairings (status reads only the active one). No device needed.

observatory_guiding_start.note: Starts this app's guide loop, which sends guide pulses: the dropped control side.

observatory_guiding_stop.note: Ends this app's guide loop. Dropped with the other hardware tools.

observatory_imaging_capture.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_imaging_check_capture.note: Checks the arguments and the delegation policy for a capture. Sends nothing to a device.

observatory_imaging_create_focus_model.note: Saves a focus model record to the database. It sends nothing to a device, but the delegation rules trust the record, and the AI is read-only. Read the saved one with observatory_imaging_status.

observatory_imaging_get_status.interim_block: The filters and focuser sections return [] and 0 because the MCP process has no hardware connection. Use app_status with the telescope section (focuser position, filter, pier side, tracking).
observatory_imaging_get_status.note: Reads the filter names, the focuser position and the saved focus model.

observatory_imaging_move_focuser.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_imaging_query_focus_models.note: Lists every saved focus model, for all telescope and camera pairings (status reads only the active one). No device needed.

observatory_imaging_set_filter.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_imaging_stop.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_get_centering_exposure.note: Built 2026-11-08. Works out the plate-solve centering exposure from the library's zero point and star width, the camera profile, the sky model and the Gaia catalog. Reads only; nothing is stored and nothing moves. The first call may fit the sky model and be slow.

observatory_mount_get_status.interim_block: Connects through connect_to_telescope, which sends CONNECTION=ON to every INDI device that is off. Blocked until it uses the connect-only path. app_status reports the mount through the backend.
observatory_mount_get_status.note: Reads the mount, filter, focuser and camera temperature. Blocked for now; see the block.

observatory_mount_move.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_park.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_set_slew_rate.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_set_tracking.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_slew.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_stop.note: Commands the mount, so it is dropped with the other hardware tools.

observatory_mount_unpark.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_remote_get_frame_locations.note: Built 2026-10-04. Counts a target's frames at the telescope, on the drive and in the library, and names the frames that are in one place but not the next. Reads only.

observatory_remote_query_files.note: Lists the FITS files in one folder on the telescope computer, with sizes. Reads only.

observatory_remote_query_folders.note: Lists folders on the telescope computer. Reads only.

observatory_safety_get_status.interim_block: The assessment section connects through connect_to_telescope, which sends CONNECTION=ON to every INDI device that is off, and enclosure_state returns unknown in the MCP process. Blocked until those sections use the connect-only path.
observatory_safety_get_status.note: Reads the safety rules, a weather verdict, the enclosure, the delegation policy and the agreement evidence for one capability. The delegation policy's live row was once written by a UI test; clean it before relying on it.

observatory_safety_set_mode.note: Writes the delegation state (the Safe Mode toggle) to the database. Not a hardware command, but the user decided an AI may not change configuration.

observatory_safety_update.note: Applies an operator's decision. Needs the operator.

planning_add_checklist_items.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_add_to_queue.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_build_deep_star_catalog.note: Downloads from Gaia for hours and writes the catalog database.

planning_calculate_panels.note: Works out mosaic panel centers. Saves nothing.

planning_create_mosaic.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_create_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_create_sequence.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_create_session.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_dismiss_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_get_calibration_advice.note: How many calibration frames of one kind the library holds, worked out on demand. Saves nothing.

planning_get_constellation_lines.note: Draws the Planetarium. Returns an empty list because of a wrong file path, and is 89 KB when fixed.

planning_get_deep_catalog_status.note: Built 2026-10-06. Reads the catalog file; the optional estimate queries the Gaia archive and saves nothing.

planning_get_depth_goal.note: Built 2026-10-27 (#134). Reads a target's depth goal: the chosen level, the depth reached and the time to reach the level. Saves nothing.

planning_get_package_for_target.note: Reads the one package that stands for a target. Reads only.

planning_get_plan.note: Built 2026-10-06. Reads one recorded session, by id or by night.

planning_get_tonight_advice.note: Tonight's ranking of targets, worked out on demand. Saves nothing.

planning_get_visibility.note: Built 2026-10-03. Where objects are now or over a night: altitude, horizon clearance with caller-given blocked ranges, meridian crossing, Sun and Moon. Reads nothing stored.

planning_lookup_coordinates.note: Built 2026-10-04. The position of a named object, from the library or SIMBAD. Reads only.

planning_query_catalogs.note: Lists the catalog drivers. Reads only.

planning_query_plans.note: Lists the recorded sessions, the observation packages or the suggestion log. Reads only.

planning_query_sources.note: Targets and stars near a point from the library, SIMBAD or the online catalogs, brightest stars first, cut at a limit with the total reported. Replaces planning_find_sources, planning_get_sources, planning_get_library_star_summaries and planning_get_online_catalog_sources.

planning_refresh_suggestions.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_remove_from_queue.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_reopen_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_reorder_queue.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_set_depth_goal.note: Writes the user's chosen depth level for a target to the database. Not a hardware command, but the user decided an AI may not change configuration.

planning_set_entry_exposures.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_set_framing.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_tick_checklist_item.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_undismiss_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_update_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

review_alignment_get_pointing_model.note: Since #206 (was review_query kind pointing_model): fits one night's pointing model. Saves nothing.

review_alignment_get_polar_alignment.note: Since #206 the home of observatory_mount_get_polar_alignment. The backend shows it; an AI reads the stored runs through review_alignment_query.

review_alignment_query.note: Since #206 review_alignment_query: the stored plate-solve attempts of a night or a time range, grouped by target, with the latest polar alignment run. Reads only.

review_alignment_query_nights.note: Since #206: one alignment summary per recorded night, newest first. Reads only.

review_alignment_record_external.note: Since #206 the home of observatory_mount_poll_external_alignment. The backend calls it to store the syncs other programs queued. It writes records, and the AI is read-only.

review_guiding_get_night.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_guiding_measure_spectrum.note: Built 2026-11-07. The guiding spectrum worked out from the recorded samples, with nights optionally left out. Unlike review_guiding_record_spectrum it stores nothing.

review_guiding_measure_unguided_error.note: Built 2026-11-07. Reads the recorded guide samples and guiding runs and fits the mount's own error (periodic error, drift, jitter). Nothing is stored or sent. Slow on a long history.

review_guiding_query_runs.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_guiding_record_spectrum.note: Since #206 the home of observatory_guiding_refit_spectrum: recomputes and stores the mount's model. The user does not want an AI to trigger it.

review_nights_get.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_nights_get_capture.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_nights_get_ekos_session.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_nights_get_live_status.note: Served 2026-10-03. force=true copies the newest Ekos and KStars logs into the wayfinding library's log folder, which is reading from the telescope computer and adds files only. Since #206 it is review_nights_get_live_status and takes no folder. Reports pier side, camera temperature, exposure counts and dither settings; the guide algorithm is not in the logs and the reply says so.

review_nights_get_recurring_issues.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_nights_get_sky_coverage.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_nights_get_target_changes.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_nights_query.note: Built 2026-10-03. Since #206 review_nights_query: the recorded nights and what data each has. The other kinds became the review_nights, review_guiding and review_alignment reads. Reads only.

review_nights_query_ekos_sessions.note: Since #206 (was a kind of review_query): reads the recorded nights and calculates one analysis. Saves nothing; the server keeps the reply under its size limit.

review_performance_get_envelope.note: Slow: reads every session and target twice.

review_performance_measure_focus_tempera.note: Built 2026-11-07. Fits the focus-versus-temperature slope on recorded autofocus runs and frame headers. Reads only; nothing is stored. Slow when it reads every frame record.

review_performance_predict_sky_rate.note: Built 2026-11-07. Predicts the sky background rate from the sky model fitted to the library's own frames. Reads only; nothing is stored. The first call fits the model and is slow.

review_targets_get_frame_guiding.note: Built 2026-10-03. Cuts the stored guide-log samples to each light frame's exposure window. Since #206 it is review_targets_get_frame_guiding and takes a frame filter. Reads only.

review_targets_get_report.note: Built 2026-10-06; split 2026-10-31. Since #206 review_targets_get_report: the target dataset report, worked out on demand. Saves nothing.

review_targets_get_result.note: Since #206 (was review_get_advisory kind result): how far one star's results can be trusted. Saves nothing.

review_targets_get_star_shapes.note: Built 2026-11-20 (#199). Says in plain words how round a target's stars are, whether the stretch points one way, and which frames stand out, from the stored star-shape measurements. Reads only; nothing is measured or stored. Corner widths are reported as not validated (AST-18).
